__comment__: Time interval for looping the configured time sources.
The new time value will be set to the system only when the time
delta between the current system time and the new value is greater
When the value of this field is greater than 0, the system uses it as the
maximum allowed times to update the system time with the specific time source.
When the system time update count with the corresponding time source reaches the
configured value, the time source will be skipped from the current loop.
When the value is -1, it means the service will ignore this field and there
is no maximum count set for the time source.
List of Clients that can set the source validity.
Need to configure valid time sources.
